decisions.reason: It fits the firm's compliance-focused expansion, appears agency-relevant with some early validation, and as a software add-on close to the core offer it is inexpensive to keep while demand learns out further.
As the firm's flagship platform direction and a core extension of its hosting business, it is strategically important and worth continued investment despite remaining uncertainty.

It is close to the existing hosting business and likely cheap to continue offering, but because it looks less differentiated and less strategically central than the platform products it has a higher risk of later rationalization.
